accepted_direction: Additive atomic provider endpoint and authenticated Gateway envelope
Explicit evidence states and common parent/child contract
Preserve local retained transport when host game observation is unknown
blocking_findings: Cross-boot delayed A could replace newer boot B without a dispatch ordinal and retired-boot fence.
Gateway controlGeneration is not a local transport generation; a distinct transportGeneration is required.
Fresh pending responses could reset liveness forever without an episode-bound non-resetting deadline.
Allowing Game and ConsoleStreamTransitionCoordinator to accept DTOs independently would retain parallel projections.
Legacy provider events can currently bypass the coherent observation fence and drive readiness.
The transition coordinator substitutes the expected game when producer game evidence is missing.
required_corrections: Use one process-wide serialized projection owner per host/actor/execution that assigns request ordinals, accepts observations and publishes one SessionSnapshot.
Echo the request ordinal and retire prior producer boot IDs so delayed responses are rejected within and across boots.
Add a distinct monotonic local transport generation in RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator and carry it in SessionSnapshot.
Bind liveness to a state episode and controlled monotonic deadline; a new revision of the same episode cannot reset it.
Make events trigger refresh only, or route versioned stateful events through the same acceptance fence.
Require explicit VERIFIED canonical target game before process/window evidence can drive privacy readiness; remove expected-game fallback.
Use producer time for diagnostics and local monotonic receipt time plus hard cap for freshness.
RECOVERY_REQUIRED must not auto-close a known live stream; recovery remains a separately authorized exact-fenced action and must be followed by a new authorized Play test.
